summary: SPACSphere Acquisition Corp., a Cayman blank-check vehicle, filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 1 to its May 29, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with Mobilewalla Holdco, Inc. The amendment expands the post-closing board from five to seven directors effective at merger consummation. No price, stake, premium, or closing date was disclosed in the excerpt. The transaction involves a Cayman-to-Delaware domestication and merger of Merger Sub into Mobilewalla, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary; the combined company will be renamed Covariate, Inc. Deal terms remain unchanged; watch for updated proxy disclosures, redemption levels, and any further amendments.
